claims.detail: Committed exemplar: Event Hubs capture feeds replay deterministically when Functions scale out under burst envelopes.

findings.description: Autoscale rules on Event Hubs still depend on manual throughput unit ceilings that may lag partner spikes.
findings.recommendation: Automate TU bumps with alerting hooks tied to partition reader lag and consumer health.

findings.description: Dead-letter reviewers need a single pane correlating Service Bus message IDs with upstream Event Hubs offsets.
findings.recommendation: Instrument Functions with OpenTelemetry spans that carry both broker identifiers end-to-end.
